verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for this kind of product. The Clerky partnership covers legal formation workflows on a partner platform, and the evidence shows no user-configurable automations, versioning, or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
